hero.lead: Minna is an online language school that keeps courses, lessons, practice and your progress in one place. It is built for people with jobs and timetables: easy to start, easy to come back to, and aimed at language you can actually use.
hero.imageAlt: A group of learners going over a lesson together

who.title: Who we are
who.quote: Minna is an online language school built on one idea: a language does not start in a textbook, it starts with the first sentence you dare to say out loud. So our lessons are short, clear, and always end with you using the language.
who.body: Japanese, English and Vietnamese sit side by side in one account, with practice, downloadable notes, and a progress record that always tells you what to study next.
who.imageAlt: A learner writing down new vocabulary during a lesson

beliefs.title: What we believe
beliefs.intro: Every course and every lesson on Minna starts from the same three ideas — a language should be easy to reach, worth using, and possible to study every day without a fight.

items.title: Lessons you can reach
items.text: Short lessons in a clear order, on a laptop, a tablet or a phone, wherever you happen to have ten minutes.

items.title: Speaking from lesson one
items.text: Every lesson carries sentences you would really say, with native audio and pronunciation practice to try them on straight away.

items.title: Keeping the streak
items.text: We remember where you stopped, count the days you studied, and bring you back to the next lesson in a single account.

practice.title: Language that works outside the lesson
practice.text: The material is built around the situations you actually meet: introducing yourself, ordering food, talking to colleagues, writing an email, sitting an interview.
checks: Dialogues from real situations, with native audio
Vocabulary and grammar summaries to review later
Every level, from no prior study to using it at work
Exercises and written work marked by your teacher, with notes
practice.link: Browse courses by language and level
practice.imageAlt: A vocabulary notebook and a language textbook on a desk

platform.title: From a lesson to a conversation
platform.lead: Start with a lesson short enough to finish in one sitting, practise the sounds, work through the exercises, and watch your own progress build — until the sentence you once memorised is simply one you can say.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: Minna respects every learner's privacy. This document explains what personal data we collect, how we use, disclose and protect it, under Thailand's Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA).

controller.heading: The data controller and how to reach us
controller.p1a: Minna ("we", "the school", "the platform") acts as the
controller.p1c: for the personal data collected through the Minna website and online language school.
controller.p2: If you have a question about this policy, want to exercise one of your rights, or wish to complain about how we handle personal data, contact our Data Protection Officer:

contact.t: Minna office (sample address for the prototype)
Within 30 days of receiving a complete request

collect.heading: The personal data we collect
collect.p1: We collect only what the service needs, in four groups.
account: Your name, email address and phone number
The languages you chose to study and the level you were placed at
The goal you picked for yourself — work, travel, or a proficiency exam
Your time zone and the language the site is displayed in
A profile photo, if you upload one
learning: Which courses you enrolled on, when you started, and when access ends
Progress lesson by lesson, video watch time, and the lesson you stopped at
Exercise answers and scores, plus written work and audio sent to a teacher
Consistency statistics, such as your study streak and total study time
payment: Order history, the courses or packages bought, amounts paid, and coupons used
Billing details for a receipt or tax invoice — taxpayer name, taxpayer number, branch and address — kept only if you ask for a tax invoice
Payment status and the transaction reference
collect.cardTitle: We never hold your card details
collect.cardText: Full card numbers, CVV codes and banking passwords are not stored on our systems. They go straight to a payment provider certified to PCI DSS.
technical: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, and device type
Access logs, sign-in times, and the pages you visited
Data stored on your own device, such as cookies and local storage

purpose.heading: Why we process your data, and on what basis
purpose.p1: We process your personal data on the legal bases set out in sections 24 and 26 of the PDPA:
purpose.caption: Table of processing purposes, the data used, and the legal basis for each
head: Purpose
Data used
Legal basis
rows: Creating and running your account, granting access
Issuing receipts and tax invoices, keeping accounting records
Recording your progress and exercise results
Suggesting courses and lessons that suit your level
Sending study reminders and marketing email
Keeping the platform secure and preventing misuse
Improving the lessons and the experience
purpose.p2a: Where we rely on consent, you
purpose.p2b: may withdraw it at any time
purpose.p2c: , without affecting any lawful processing carried out before the withdrawal.

cookies.heading: Cookies and tracking technologies
cookies.p1: We use cookies and local storage to keep the platform working and to remember your settings. There are three kinds:

items.t: — your sign-in state, your chosen language, and your cart. These cannot be turned off.
— counts visitors and routes through the site without identifying anyone, so we can improve the lessons.
— used only with your consent, to measure advertising and show you relevant courses.

cookies.p2: You can delete or refuse cookies in your browser settings, but turning off the necessary ones will stop you signing in and opening a course.

share.heading: Disclosure to third parties
share.p1b: do not sell, rent or trade
share.p1c: your personal data for anyone else's marketing. We disclose only what is necessary, to:

items.t: — to take payment, check transactions and issue refunds
— cloud hosting, email delivery and video streaming, each bound by a data processing agreement
— only the written work and audio that has to be marked, shown with the learner's name
— aggregated, non-identifying data only, to measure and improve the lessons
— on a lawful order

share.p2: Where data is transferred abroad — to a cloud provider, for instance — we make sure the destination offers adequate protection, or apply the safeguards the PDPA requires.

retention.heading: How long we keep your data
retention.p1: We keep data only as long as the purpose requires, then delete it or render it non-identifying.
retention.caption: Table of retention periods by data type
head: Data type
Retention period
rows: While the account is open, and one year after it closes
Three years from your last study session

rights.heading: Your rights over your personal data
rights.p1: Under the PDPA you have the following rights:

items.t: — to learn what data we hold about you and receive a copy
— most of it you can correct yourself, on
— once the purpose has passed, or once you withdraw consent
— while we are checking whether the data is accurate
— particularly to processing for direct marketing
— to receive your data in a machine-readable form
— at any time, without affecting processing already done
— to the Personal Data Protection Committee office

rights.p2: send your request, with proof of identity, to the Data Protection Officer's address in section 1. We answer within 30 days, and may ask for more information to confirm the request really comes from you.
rights.p3: If erasing your data makes the service impossible to provide — closing your account, for instance — any remaining course access ends at the same time, and this does not create a right to a refund.

security.heading: How we keep your data safe
items: Every page is served over HTTPS/TLS
Passwords are stored as one-way hashes; nobody on the team can read yours
Access to data is limited by role, and every access is logged for review
Backups run regularly, and restores are tested on a schedule
Risks are reviewed and systems updated against current security standards
security.p1: If a breach occurs that poses a high risk to your rights and freedoms, we notify the Personal Data Protection Committee office within 72 hours and tell you without delay.

minors.heading: Data about minors
minors.p1: The service is open to people aged 13 and over. Learners under 20 need a parent or guardian's consent before signing up and before every payment, and we may ask for evidence of that consent.
minors.p2: If we learn that we have collected a minor's data without valid consent, we delete it as quickly as we can.

changes.heading: Changes to this policy
changes.p1: We may revise this policy from time to time to keep up with the service and with the law. The version in force is always the one published on this page.
changes.p2: Where a change is material, we tell you at least 30 days in advance, by email or by a notice on the platform, before it takes effect.

terms.lead: These terms are the agreement between you and Minna covering your use of the Minna online language school. Signing up or using the service means you have read and accepted all of them.

— a parent or guardian must consent before signing up and before each payment

Tell us at once if you suspect your account has been accessed without your permission

access.p2: We may revise, extend or correct course content to keep it current, and may withdraw a course from sale — anyone who already has access keeps it until it expires.

ip.heading: Intellectual property
ip.p1: Everything on the platform — video, slides, documents, audio, images, exercises and the arrangement of the lessons — belongs to Minna or to the teachers who licensed it to us. What you receive is permission to view it for your own study, and nothing more.
forbidden: Recording the screen, downloading, or reproducing video and documents by any means
Publishing, forwarding or selling the content to anyone else, paid or free
Using the content to teach, or in your own material, without written permission
Adapting, translating, or making derivative works from our content
Using automated tools to extract data or content from the system
ip.p2: Documents explicitly marked "downloadable" may be downloaded for your own revision only, and still may not be passed on. Infringement can lead to account suspension and legal action.

quizzes.heading: Quizzes and how we assess your work
rules: Multiple-choice questions may be retaken without limit; your best score is kept as the result for that lesson
Written work and audio recordings go to a teacher, who normally returns them within seven working days
The pass mark for each lesson is shown on the course page before you start
Having someone else take a quiz for you is cheating, and every result will be voided
quizzes.p1: Progress and scores are recorded automatically for every lesson, and you can look back over them from your account for as long as the account is open. All of it is internal to Minna.
quizzes.h3: 6.3 What a Minna level does not mean
quizzes.noticeTitle: Levels and scores are internal to Minna
quizzes.noticeText: The levels and scores on the platform exist to put lessons in the right order for you. They are not an official proficiency result and cannot be cited to a school, an employer or a government body.
quizzes.p2: If you need a result you can cite, sit the official examination for that language with the body that runs it. Our courses are designed to help you prepare, but we do not guarantee the outcome.

prohibited.heading: What you must not do
items: Share your account, password or lesson links with anyone who has no access
Record, reproduce or publish the platform's content anywhere
Attempt to break into the system, probe it for weaknesses, or get around access controls
Use automated tools, scripts or bots to extract data or create accounts in bulk
Post advertising, scams or unlawful material in the question-and-answer areas
Threaten, insult or discriminate against other learners and teachers
Use someone else's details to sign up or to pay

liability.noticeText: The content is made for studying a language on your own. How far you get depends on the time and consistency you put in. Minna does not guarantee your progress, your result in any external proficiency exam, or any professional outcome.
items: We are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, or for lost opportunity
We do not warrant that the service will be uninterrupted or entirely free of error
We are not liable for problems caused by your own device, network or software
We are not liable for events beyond our reasonable control

liability.p1: None of the above applies to liability arising from our wilful misconduct or gross negligence, or to liability the law does not permit us to limit.

law.p1: These terms are governed by Thai law, and any dispute falls under the jurisdiction of the Thai courts.
law.p2: We may amend these terms from time to time. Where a change is material we give at least 30 days' notice by email or by a notice on the platform. Continuing to use the service after the effective date means you accept the amended version.
law.p3: If any clause turns out to be void or unenforceable, the rest remain in full effect.

price.leadT: — the figure on the course page is the amount you pay.

We may change prices at any time; a change never affects an order already paid for

complaint.p1: If you believe a refund decision was unfair, raise it with us here:

contact.t: Within 15 working days of receiving the complaint

complaint.p2: If it still cannot be settled, you may complain to the Office of the Consumer Protection Board or another competent authority.

items.q: I opened one lesson. Can I still get a refund?
items.a: Yes. If your total progress is still 20% or less and you ask within 7 days of paying, you get 50% of what you paid back.

items.q: My access expired before I finished. What now?
items.a: Buy access again from the course page. The full period starts over and you carry on from the progress already saved. Expired access is not itself grounds for a refund.

items.q: Can I get a tax invoice after the fact?
items.a: Yes, within 7 days of the order: contact us with your order number and your taxpayer details. After that the accounting period has closed and we cannot issue one.

items.q: Can I buy a course as a gift?
items.a: Not yet. Access is tied to the account that bought it and cannot be transferred. To buy for several people at once, contact us about organisation terms.

items.q: Can I study several languages at once, and how is that charged?
items.a: You can. Each language is a separate course, or you can take a package that already covers several. Progress in all of them stays in one account.
